normalisation.policy: BEDTIME_STORY programme target. SONG and STORY targets are TBD from listening tests, not inherited from this one.
normalisation.why: the raw bed measured mean -52.3 dB / max -38.6 dB — present but inaudible. -20 LUFS is Coco Spark's deliberate bedtime target. NOT justified by what YouTube does to loud material: platform normalisation is not a reason for an artistic choice, and inheriting it into channel policy would be borrowing a decision from someone else's product.

audio.rate_note: loudnorm upsamples internally and left the mux at 96kHz, which is non-standard for delivery. Pinned back to 48kHz explicitly rather than shipping whatever the filter graph happened to leave behind.

note: picture uses RELEASE CANDIDATES, not raw clips: s01 is the stabilised derivative
